main.description: A segment, with the signed-in viewer's own fastest effort on it.

elevationProfile.description: The segment's terrain profile, only when segment.elevationSource is terrain. No other query carries it.

routeMembers.description: The other segments of its route (segments/segment-routes) the viewer could get from a segment search, earliest indexed first. Absent or empty when it is alone, and for a lift.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: The segment isn't indexed, or isn't served: its account is suspended or taken down, or the record is.

routeMember.description: Another segment of the route, enough to offer it and say which way it goes.

line.description: Its line, as feed.segment's line is encoded.
